name: @crumb/demos
description: Demo content pipeline — Playwright captures the seeded app, Remotion polishes it into README GIFs, PNG screenshots, and a landing-page video. NOT a pnpm workspace member (kept out of app build/CI).

scripts.video: remotion render remotion/index.ts LandingHero out/landing.mp4 --overwrite && remotion render remotion/index.ts LandingHero out/landing.webm --overwrite
scripts.all: pnpm run seed && pnpm run stage && pnpm run capture && pnpm run measure && pnpm run gif && pnpm run video
